comments.author: @WeirdWizardDave
comments.text: Its really sad to see OpenAI effectively abandon the principle that they're building AI for humanity as a whole and not their investors. Its exactly what I didn't want to see come from this drama. They're already raking in huge amounts and could have brought in tons more investment had they needed to on the same max 100x terms. By perpetually raising the cap each year they're basically saying its okay if our investors end up with all the money which has always been one of the huge dangers with AI. That it supercharges inequality by giving a few all the power and wealth. Sad day, well I guess we can only hope the open source and more enlightened forces (both inside and outside OpenAI) prevail in what is probably going to be the most important ideological fight in human history.
